_question: Black metal (v3): does each essential state change keep an equivalent non-motion communication under reduced motion? Mappings are from the full-motion carrier to the reduced carrier.

mappings.full: spring rotation of the rack; the logo fades out in 120 ms and the caption's title, description and meta fade out
mappings.reduced: instant reposition; the position number and index row change immediately

mappings.full: the case pulls straight out, turns and floats to the presentation spot (gated springs)
mappings.reduced: the gate sequence resolves within one frame; the case is shown presented

mappings.full: the logo opens from its centre line outward over 640 ms; the caption fades in over 160 ms
mappings.reduced: the logo and the caption appear at once; the status region announces the case in both modes

mappings.full: front leaf swings on its hinge beside the spread
mappings.reduced: case shown open beside the spread

mappings.full: the sheet slides in from the right in 220 ms
mappings.reduced: the sheet is shown without movement; focus moves to Close

mappings.full: the index fades in over the page in 160 ms
mappings.reduced: the index appears at once; focus moves to Find

mappings.full: on filter or sort, cases sink through the floor, re-slot unseen and rise from the front out
mappings.reduced: slots change in place at once; the index shows the new order

mappings.full: decorative only: every 15 to 40 s the page inverts for two flashes inside 170 ms; it carries no information
mappings.reduced: never shown; nothing is lost, because the flicker communicates nothing
